name: Oozeerally, NB
habitat_note: Confined to remnants of altitudinal indigenous forest in Mauritius.
notes: It has become very rare. The species is endemic to the Mascarene, where it occurs in  Reunion and Mauritius. Very rare in Mauritius. A decoction of the bark is used for fever. It is a good tonic and is also used for childhood eczema or stomach cramps.

name: Oozeerally, NB
